query: UPDATE schedules SET consecutive_failures = consecutive_failures + 1, next_run_at = $2, enabled = enabled AND consecutive_failures + 1 < $3, failure_streak_pure_connectivity = failure_streak_pure_connectivity AND $5, auto_disabled_agent_unreachable = CASE WHEN (failure_streak_pure_connectivity AND $5) AND consecutive_failures + 1 >= $3 THEN true ELSE auto_disabled_agent_unreachable END, auto_disabled_by_agent_id = CASE WHEN (failure_streak_pure_connectivity AND $5) AND consecutive_failures + 1 >= $3 THEN $4 ELSE auto_disabled_by_agent_id END WHERE id = $1 RETURNING consecutive_failures, enabled, auto_disabled_agent_unreachable
